purpose: Teach: 和平/冥福/旺盛/平穏/献身/憎しみ/推論/分泌

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合との和平を模索しろ
lines.en: Find a path toward reconciliation with our competitors.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Clear diction on each clause. Steady tempo, no hesitation. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard and obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。先代の社長のご冥福を新人にも伝えております
lines.en: Understood. We're making sure the new staff are informed about the previous president's passing.
lines.style: Respectful, formal acknowledgement. Slight pause after the affirmative. Careful pronunciation of the sensitive detail. Even pace, grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、旺盛な需要を取り逃がすな
lines.en: Don't let us miss the momentum in demand right now.
lines.style: Sharp, directive. Emphasis on the negative imperative. Clipped pace. The weight of urgency without raising volume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。平穏な社内環境づくりを進めます
lines.en: Understood. We're working to build a stable working environment inside the company.
lines.style: Deliberate, reassuring tone. Slight nod in the voice on 'understood.' Calm, committed delivery. A promise being made aloud.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の献身的な働きを認めろ
lines.en: Acknowledge the dedication your staff is showing you.
lines.style: Direct instruction, not unkind. Steady rhythm. A quiet insistence that this matters. No room for negotiation, but grounded in principle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。SNSでの憎しみコメントには毅然と対応します
lines.en: Understood. We're handling hostile comments on social media with resolve and professionalism.
lines.style: Firm, protecting. Slight steel underneath the politeness. No apology in the delivery. Standing ground without defensiveness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 市場動向から推論される結果を社内、共有しろ
lines.en: Share what the market trends tell us about where we're heading—make sure everyone knows.
lines.style: Authoritative but inviting. Cadence that suggests this is strategic, not just urgent. Pause before the second clause. Expectant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。健康食品の分泌促進効果を訴求しております
lines.en: Understood. We're emphasizing the health benefits our products deliver to customers.
lines.style: Professional closing affirmation. Slightly softer than previous responses—this is a shift to marketing-speak. Steady, sales-oriented delivery.
